verdict.headline: AI demand dominates overnight — SKHY 7x oversubscribed, AVGO Apple deal — but Iran Day 2 and hawkish Fed keep regime on hold
verdict.rationale_short: The overnight tape is a tale of two forces: a strong AI/semi demand narrative versus a persistently hostile macro regime. On the constructive side: (1) SKHY, the $28B SK Hynix Nasdaq ADR, drew 7x oversubscription with total orders of ~$171.5B — the clearest institutional validation of the HBM4/AI memory thesis since the IBIT Gate 3 confirmation. (2) AVGO extended its Apple chip partnership through 2031 in a $30B+ deal, powering it +4.83% on July 8 and +1.35% in pre-market to $393.94. (3) Asia reversed sharply — KOSPI +3.7%, Nikkei +1.65%, SK Hynix KRX +7.76%, Samsung +4%, Kioxia +8.14% — the deepest two-session Asia reversal since Q1. (4) S&P futures +0.3%, Nasdaq-100 futures +0.5%, implying an open well above the 7,460 dual-gate floor. (5) Brent pulled back 0.5% to $77.60, signaling the market is not pricing full Hormuz closure. On the restrictive side: (1) NVDA pre-market $195.09 — $0.09 above the $195 mandatory stop, a knife's edge; four-gate check at 9:25 AM ET (NVDA >$200 AND SPX >7,460 AND VIX <17 simultaneously) is almost certainly NOT triggered at $195.09. (2) VIX closed July 8 at 16.90, dangerously close to the 17 regime threshold; Iran conflict is in Day 2 of kinetic exchange with Trump warning of 'much worse' strikes ahead. (3) FOMC September hike probability 68.8%; 30Y yield at 5.10% (above 5.00% trigger). (4) PepsiCo Q2 EPS $2.20 (slight miss vs $2.21 estimate), signaling North American consumer demand weakness even as international revenue beats. The verdict is 🟡 HOLD: the AI narrative is winning the overnight session, but macro regime gates (VIX, NVDA stop, hawkish Fed, Iran) preclude a full BUY. Watch the 9:25 AM ET four-gate check — if NVDA rallies through $200 on the open, the BUY regime activates.

bear_case: The dual-gate BUY regime survived July 8 on the thinnest possible margin: VIX 16.90 (0.10 units below 17 threshold), SPX 7,482 (22 points above 7,460 floor). The constructive overnight session (Asia recovery, SKHY demand) is masking two structural fault lines. First, the Iran conflict entered Day 2 of kinetic exchange — the US launched strikes on 90 targets in Iran; Tehran retaliated against Qatar, Bahrain, and Kuwait; Trump explicitly warned of 'much worse' to come. This is not de-escalation language. A third round of strikes, particularly targeting Iranian civilian infrastructure, would trigger a Hormuz closure attempt that Brent at $77.60 is not yet pricing. Second, the Fed's structural shift — first-ever dot withholding by a sitting Chair, 68.8% September hike probability, 30Y above 5.00% — means the stock market now has no Fed put at anything above 3.5% CPI. If June CPI on July 14 prints at 4.2%+ (consensus) alongside a Brent that has not meaningfully retreated, the September hike becomes the base case and SPX forward multiples compress. NVDA at $195.09 pre-market has zero margin for error: a single adverse development before 9:25 AM ET pushes it below $195, triggering Stop Day 2 (mandatory full exit at July 10 open). The SKHY 7x oversubscription is the most significant constructive data point, but it is a demand signal for HBM4 memory — it does not offset the macro regime headwinds on rate-sensitive growth multiples. Counter-argument: if NVDA sustains above $200 at 9:25 AM ET AND VIX opens and holds below 16 → the HOLD call is wrong and BUY Day protocol activates. That requires Nasdaq to rally roughly 0.5%+ above current pre-market levels.
